rounds.q: A movie is really a string of still pictures. How many flash by each second?
rounds.why: Most silent films were shot and shown slower than that, says the Library of Congress.
rounds.src: Library of Congress, Now See Hear! blog, The Sound of Silents (2014)
rounds.fun: 24 still pictures a second, and your eyes happily call it a movie!

rounds.q: What year did the first full-length computer-animated movie come out?
rounds.why: It was Toy Story. The Academy calls it the first computer-animated feature film.
rounds.src: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, Collection Highlights: Toy Story (1995 release)
rounds.fun: The first computer-animated feature film arrived in 1995!

rounds.q: How many quarts of popcorn does the average American eat in a year?
rounds.why: All together, Americans eat about 14 billion quarts of popcorn a year.
rounds.src: The Popcorn Board, Media Kit (average of 2016-2020 sales)
rounds.fun: 43 quarts each, 14 billion quarts all together. Pass the bucket!

rounds.q: What year did the first drive-in movie theater open?
rounds.why: It opened near Camden, New Jersey, at 25 cents per car plus 25 cents per person.
rounds.src: PBS American Experience, Looking Back at the Original Drive-In Movie Theater (1933 event)
rounds.fun: In 1933 a quarter got your car in, and each person paid a quarter too.

rounds.q: How many movie tickets were sold in the US and Canada in 2025?
rounds.why: That is about two per person. At the 2002 peak it was 1,570 million, almost five each.
rounds.src: Pew Research Center, citing Nash Information Services ticket data (2025 data)
rounds.fun: 769 million tickets is about two each. Back in 2002 it was almost five!
